title: buddleja grandiflora var. genuina
intro: Buddleja grandiflora var. genuina, commonly known as Butterfly Bush, is a flowering plant species within the Buddlejaceae family. This plant is known for its long, conical flower spikes, which attract various pollinators and butterflies. The health benefits of Buddleja grandiflora var. genuina include its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, which may contribute to its therapeutic properties in managing conditions such as anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic effects.
